label: rem:tannaka-dual-remark
title: The Tannaka dual as an emergent gauge group
html: The gauge group emerges from the pair (\mathbf{C}, \tau) alone. When (\mathbf{C}, \tau) is neutral Tannakian in the algebraic Tannakian formalism of Neantro Saavedra Rivano [saavedra-rivano1972] and Pierre Deligne [deligne1990], the Tannaka dual G is an affine group scheme over R and the reconstruction \mathbf{C} \simeq \mathrm{Rep}(G) holds.
heading: Remark
